shot: RA-07 round 4 'Gym closed': one take, START to END, same locked camera
intent: A man in a black t-shirt and black shorts walks along the sidewalk toward the glass door of a gym. A printed red and white CLOSED sign hangs on the inside of the glass. START: mid-stride, eyes on the door, has not stopped. END: same camera, he has stopped, feet planted, both palms up and empty at waist height, shoulders dropped, head tilted, a resigned look at the sign. The door, the sign, the building, the sidewalk and the dark gym interior do not move.

hands.right: empty, hanging in START; palm up, empty, in END
hands.left: empty, swinging back in START; palm up, empty, in END
